Elderly Couple in Their 80s Left Partially Undressed on Paris Street Amid Violent Riots

Eddie “The Hebrew” Hammer

October 18, 2026 11:23 pm

 views

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:07
Instaread

Disturbing images emerging from the French capital show an elderly couple in their 80s left partially undressed in the street amid violent unrest that has seen businesses looted, property destroyed, and civilians caught in the chaos.

Stay informed with JBN email alerts! Get the latest updates on breaking stories, global events, and community news directly in your inbox.

The couple was allegedly robbed of their personal belongings and clothing as violence spread through the city, with luxury retailers targeted, businesses ransacked, and police confronting rioters.

While some media outlets have described participants in the unrest as “student protesters,” footage circulating online shows individuals engaging in looting and destruction of property.

It remains unclear why individuals described as “student protesters” would allegedly strip an elderly couple in their 80s of their clothing, in addition to stealing their personal possessions.

Although the photographs document the couple’s partially undressed condition, the identities of those responsible and the circumstances of the alleged robbery have not been independently established.

The images have intensified concerns about public safety and the ability of French authorities to protect vulnerable residents amid the escalating unrest.
